description: This file defines TypeScript types and functions related to bundled plugin build entries, including data structures for build entries and parameters, as well as functions to collect and list build entries, artifacts, and dependencies.

methods.name: export function collectBundledPluginBuildEntries( collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Returns an array of BundledPluginBuildEntry objects based on provided parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Returns a record/map of bundled plugin build entries with string keys and values.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of strings representing package artifacts.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Returns a list of strings representing runtime dependencies for the bundled plugin.
